module roman
  purpose: Convert integers from 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and back.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Why a conversion was refused.
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  BadNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Entry
  purpose: One Roman symbol together with its integer value.
  has amount: Integer
  has glyph: Text
end

function entries() returns List of Entry
  purpose: The symbols in descending order, including the subtractive pairs.

  return [
    Entry(amount: 1000, glyph: "M"),
    Entry(amount: 900, glyph: "CM"),
    Entry(amount: 500, glyph: "D"),
    Entry(amount: 400, glyph: "CD"),
    Entry(amount: 100, glyph: "C"),
    Entry(amount: 90, glyph: "XC"),
    Entry(amount: 50, glyph: "L"),
    Entry(amount: 40, glyph: "XL"),
    Entry(amount: 10, glyph: "X"),
    Entry(amount: 9, glyph: "IX"),
    Entry(amount: 5, glyph: "V"),
    Entry(amount: 4, glyph: "IV"),
    Entry(amount: 1, glyph: "I")
  ]
end

public function to_roman(number: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Write an integer from 1 to 3999 as a Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if number is less than 1 or number is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: number)
  end
  let mutable remaining be number
  let mutable result be ""
  for each entry in entries()
    repeat until remaining is less than entry.amount
      set result to "{result}{entry.glyph}"
      set remaining to remaining - entry.amount
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Read a canonical upper-case Roman numeral as an integer from 1 to 3999.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  if numeral.is_empty() then
    fail with BadNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  let mutable rest be numeral
  let mutable total be 0
  for each entry in entries()
    repeat until not rest.starts_with(entry.glyph)
      set total to total + entry.amount
      set rest to rest.drop(entry.glyph.length())
    end
  end
  if not rest.is_empty() then
    fail with BadNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with BadNumeral(text: numeral)
  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with BadNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  return total
end

test "every number survives a round trip"
  let mutable number be 1
  repeat until number is greater than 3999
    let numeral be to_roman(number) otherwise crash with "unreachable: {number}"
    let back be from_roman(numeral) otherwise crash with "unreachable: {numeral}"
    check back is number
    set number to number + 1
  end
end

module roman

  InvalidNumeral(input: Text)

type Glyph
  purpose: One Roman symbol or subtractive pair with its value.
  has amount: Integer
  has text: Text
end

function glyph_table() returns List of Glyph
  purpose: List every symbol and subtractive pair from largest to smallest.

  return [
    Glyph(amount: 1000, text: "M"),
    Glyph(amount: 900, text: "CM"),
    Glyph(amount: 500, text: "D"),
    Glyph(amount: 400, text: "CD"),
    Glyph(amount: 100, text: "C"),

    Glyph(amount: 50, text: "L"),
    Glyph(amount: 40, text: "XL"),
    Glyph(amount: 10, text: "X"),
    Glyph(amount: 9, text: "IX"),
    Glyph(amount: 5, text: "V"),
    Glyph(amount: 4, text: "IV"),
    Glyph(amount: 1, text: "I")
  ]
end

public function to_roman(number: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to its Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if number is less than 1 or number is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(number: number)
  end
  let mutable remaining be number
  let mutable result be ""
  for each glyph in glyph_table()
    repeat until remaining is less than glyph.amount
      set result to "{result}{glyph.text}"
      set remaining to remaining - glyph.amount
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical upper-case Roman numeral to an integer.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  if numeral.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(input: numeral)
  end
  let mutable rest be numeral
  let mutable total be 0
  repeat until rest.is_empty()
    let found be
      for each glyph in glyph_table()
      where rest.starts_with(glyph.text)
      first
    let matched be found otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(input: numeral)
    set total to total + matched.amount
    set rest to rest.drop(matched.text.length())
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(input: numeral)
  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(input: numeral)
  end
  return total

module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between Integers from 1 to 3999 and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Why a conversion to or from a Roman numeral failed.
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  BadNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Glyph
  purpose: One Roman symbol paired with the amount it stands for.
  has amount: Integer
  has symbol: Text
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Write an Integer from 1 to 3999 as a Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end
  let table be [
    Glyph(amount: 1000, symbol: "M"),
    Glyph(amount: 900, symbol: "CM"),
    Glyph(amount: 500, symbol: "D"),
    Glyph(amount: 400, symbol: "CD"),
    Glyph(amount: 100, symbol: "C"),
    Glyph(amount: 90, symbol: "XC"),
    Glyph(amount: 50, symbol: "L"),
    Glyph(amount: 40, symbol: "XL"),
    Glyph(amount: 10, symbol: "X"),
    Glyph(amount: 9, symbol: "IX"),
    Glyph(amount: 5, symbol: "V"),
    Glyph(amount: 4, symbol: "IV"),
    Glyph(amount: 1, symbol: "I")
  ]
  let mutable remaining be value
  let mutable result be ""
  for each entry in table
    repeat until remaining is less than entry.amount
      set result to "{result}{entry.symbol}"
      set remaining to remaining - entry.amount
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Read a canonical upper-case Roman numeral as an Integer.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with BadNumeral(text: text)
  end
  let digits be {"I": 1, "V": 5, "X": 10, "L": 50, "C": 100, "D": 500, "M": 1000}
  let mutable total be 0
  let mutable highest be 0
  for each symbol in text.characters().reversed()
    let digit be digits.get(symbol) otherwise fail with BadNumeral(text: text)
    if digit is less than highest then
      set total to total - digit
    otherwise
      set total to total + digit
    end
    set highest to highest.at_least(digit)
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with BadNumeral(text: text)
  if canonical is not text then
    fail with BadNumeral(text: text)
  end
  return total
end

module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert integers from 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and back.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Why a conversion to or from a Roman numeral failed.
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  InvalidNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Symbol
  purpose: One Roman glyph or subtractive pair with its value.
  has value: Integer
  has glyph: Text
end

function symbol_table()
  returns List of Symbol
  purpose: The glyphs in descending order of value, including subtractive pairs.

  return [
    Symbol(value: 1000, glyph: "M"),
    Symbol(value: 900, glyph: "CM"),
    Symbol(value: 500, glyph: "D"),
    Symbol(value: 400, glyph: "CD"),
    Symbol(value: 100, glyph: "C"),
    Symbol(value: 90, glyph: "XC"),
    Symbol(value: 50, glyph: "L"),
    Symbol(value: 40, glyph: "XL"),
    Symbol(value: 10, glyph: "X"),
    Symbol(value: 9, glyph: "IX"),
    Symbol(value: 5, glyph: "V"),
    Symbol(value: 4, glyph: "IV"),
    Symbol(value: 1, glyph: "I")
  ]
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Write an integer from 1 to 3999 as a Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end
  let mutable remaining be value
  let mutable result be ""
  for each entry in symbol_table()
    repeat until remaining is less than entry.value
      set result to result + entry.glyph
      set remaining to remaining - entry.value
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Read a canonical upper-case Roman numeral from I to MMMCMXCIX as an integer.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  let mutable rest be text
  let mutable total be 0
  for each entry in symbol_table()
    repeat until not rest.starts_with(entry.glyph)
      set rest to rest.drop(entry.glyph.length())
      set total to total + entry.value
    end
  end
  if not rest.is_empty() or total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  if canonical is not text then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  return total
end
